dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from Claude Compliance, keyed by dataflow ID.

anthropic-compliance-logs

object

Audit activity logs from the Anthropic Compliance API, such as SSO sign-ins, API key lifecycle events, member and role changes, and Claude chat and file access. Cloud SIEM uses these logs to detect security-sensitive activity. Requires an Anthropic Enterprise plan with the Compliance API enabled in the organization's Data and privacy settings. Without it, this dataflow collects no data. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, so it appears in responses only.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Always true, because this collection cannot be turned off.

status

object

Read-only collection status of a dataflow.

health

enum

Collection health of a single dataflow. Allowed enum values: DATAFLOW_HEALTH_OK,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_BROKEN,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_UNKNOWN

message

string

Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.

updated_at

date-time

Time the status was last computed.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the Claude Compliance integration account.

id [required]

string

Server-generated unique identifier of the Claude Compliance integration account.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating a Claude Compliance integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update a Claude Compliance integration account. Every field is optional. Only the provided fields are changed.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the Claude Compliance integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use an Anthropic Admin API key with the read:compliance_activities scope, or a dedicated Compliance Access key. Only the provided fields are changed. To keep the stored token, omit token.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token

string

Secret token used to authenticate with Claude Compliance.

name

string

Human-readable name of the Claude Compliance integration account.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the Claude Compliance integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
